editorial:
Imagine waking up and realizing your biggest passion is actually the thing trying to take you out. You get pulled into a world where the things you love most turn into your worst nightmares, and the vibe is just totally creepy from the start. The main characters feel like real people you would know, which makes it way scarier when things start going wrong. It feels like a dark ride at a theme park where you want to get off but you just can't stop watching what happens next.

The acting is top-notch and the twists really catch you off guard, though some parts in the middle move a bit slow. If you like movies that mess with your head, you need to see this. It is the perfect pick for a Friday night with friends when you want something that will keep you talking long after the credits roll.
endingExplained: You find out that the main character was actually creating the monsters based on their own hidden desires. In the final scene, the protagonist realizes they cannot escape the cycle because they love the thrill of the hunt too much. They end up becoming the new villain of the story, trapping the next victim in the same game. It is a sad but shocking twist that shows how obsession can totally ruin a person.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and unexpected twists.
